description: Storm Vessel default look, PIXEL-SAMPLED from design/reference/storm_vessel-character-sheet.png (service venv PIL, python -P): the six palette chips (intake.json swatches: VESSEL BLUE 156,205,241 / LIGHT BLUE 150,201,239 / WHITE 247,247,247 / METAL GRAY 143,148,159 / ORANGE 254,102,2 / YELLOW ORANGE 254,175,20) plus direct medians of the drawn surfaces (FRONT view unless noted). GLOW (drawn on the sheet): the core, the filaments (neck spray, core strands, arm bursts), the arm-burst discs, the neck interior, the lightning bolt and its sparks only; the blue / white / grey pieces are not emissive. Tiers x material emission_strength 1.5 stay under the 2.0 cap.
